name: panels-cargo-1-candled-pod-sealed
refs: REFERENCE for the pod's shape, charcoal shell, russet-and-cream cap, cream sealing band and pale dots: keep this pod's form and proportions. Ignore the magenta ground and the small leaf mark and crack on the cap.
prompt: A single painted element on a FLAT, uniform magenta ground #FF00FF: no vignette, no texture, no frame, nothing else in the picture. The subject: the same egg-shaped pod as the reference, seen front-on, sealed (no crack), standing on nothing (no floor, no shadow on the ground). It is candled from below by a warm incubator lamp: the shell glows translucent and amber from the bottom, a soft honey light rising through the shell, fading to charcoal towards the cap; the cream sealing band and the pale dots stay readable. The MIDDLE of the shell is thin and see-through like backlit horn: a soft, clearly lighter, warm, almost empty glow area in the centre of the body, the rim of the shell stays solid and opaque. NO creature, NO silhouette, NO shape inside. Matte, soft-lit painted finish like a grown-up game illustration, clean edges against the ground, no magenta spill on the shell. NO text, NO hands, NO frame, NO neon, NO cartoon outline.
